trials.claim: Automatically links related posts to boost SEO and engage users
trials.claimQuote: Automatically link related posts to boost SEO and engage users with relevant content.
trials.reasoning: Reviewers confirm it automatically links related content, helps visitors navigate, and supports SEO through internal linking. The complaints concern specific linking methods like taxonomy or existing copy, not whether automatic related-post linking works.

exhibits.quote: It won't link by taxonomy, tags, or published date.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer reports the automatic linking failed to work by taxonomy or tags.

exhibits.quote: I wanted something that creates links using existing copy, but it does not do that.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer reports the plugin does not create links using existing copy as expected.

exhibits.quote: I love how it automatically links related content within my site, making it easier for visitors to navigate and find more valuable information.
exhibits.argument: This confirms automatic linking of related content that helps visitors navigate and engage.

exhibits.quote: Want to make your content search optimized and look fabulous at the same time? Google loves internal linking, and this app makes internal links look inviting and actionable.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the plugin supports SEO through internal linking that is inviting and actionable.

trials.claim: Inserts related posts inside content using categories, keywords, titles or AI analysis
trials.claimQuote: Automatically insert related posts directly inside your content using categories, keywords, titles, or AI-powered content analysis.
trials.reasoning: A reviewer reports it will not link by taxonomy or tags, which directly conflicts with the promised insertion using categories and similar criteria. General praise for automated links and AI does not show the category/taxonomy method works.

exhibits.quote: It won't link by taxonomy, tags, or published date.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer reports insertion by taxonomy and tags did not work.

exhibits.quote: wish it will do the same for the post to pages also.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer reports linking works for posts but not for pages.

exhibits.quote: Excellent tool for inserting automated internal links into your posts.
exhibits.argument: This confirms automated insertion of internal links directly into posts.

exhibits.quote: And with the new AI link selection feature, it’s become absolutely fantastic—it has greatly improved the functionality.
exhibits.argument: This confirms AI-powered link selection functionality works as promised.

trials.claim: Supports OpenAI, Ollama, WooCommerce products, shortcodes and custom layouts with click statistics
trials.claimQuote: Supports OpenAI, Ollama, WooCommerce products, shortcodes, and custom layouts, with optional click statistics.
trials.reasoning: The binding terms do not guarantee compatibility with third-party plugins, materially limiting the WooCommerce support claim, and a reviewer reports the included designs are pretty limited. No exhibit confirms the OpenAI, Ollama, shortcode, or click-statistics parts.

exhibits.quote: We do not guarantee compatibility with any additional third party plugins, scripts, or applications.
exhibits.argument: The vendor disclaims guaranteed compatibility with third-party plugins, scripts or applications.

exhibits.quote: It takes a lot of trail and error to get the desired result (no live preview) and the included designs are pretty limited.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer reports the included designs are limited and hard to configure.
